content.text:
I've submitted index 18 (In 0.41 / Sb 0.59) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE of the three I measured, but all three values are very small, so this library shows almost no photoactivity at 2.4 eV.

| Index | In / Sb | Nearby known phase | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 0.79 / 0.21 | In11Sb3O24 | about 0 |
| 15 | 0.51 / 0.49 | InSbO4 | 0.0046 |
| 18 | 0.41 / 0.59 | between InSbO4 and In3Sb5O12 | 0.0068 |

- **How I chose:** before each measurement I checked the nearby known phases' stability and band gap predictions. I started with index 5 because its phase was stable and predicted to absorb 2.4 eV light (1.9 eV gap). It gave nothing, so I moved to the stable InSbO4 phase (2.2 eV gap). The last measurement went to index 18, which the Gaussian-process model suggested next.
- **What's untested:** EQE rose steadily toward the Sb-rich end, but I ran out of merit measurements before trying indices 20–28. The best composition in the library may be there, and I can't rule that out.
- **Not used:** I didn't spend any of the 5 XRD measurements, so the phase assignments above are inferred from composition, not confirmed.
